arguments.sql: SELECT printf('%05d', ml.zip) AS zip_code, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'MA' AND ml.zip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ml.zip ORDER BY txn_count DESC, ml.zip ASC LIMIT 1
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions by ZIP code for Massachusetts merchant locations and returns the ZIP with the highest count, formatted as a five-digit text value.
assumptions: Location is the transaction's merchant location (merchant_location_id), with state = 'MA'.
Counts all transactions regardless of fraud label, since the question asks for total transactions.
Locations with NULL ZIP are excluded.
ZIP is stored as an integer, so it is zero-padded to five digits as text (leading zeros restored).
